cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is United 805 on a flight to Guangzhou, you are approaching Whiskey X-Ray India, maintaining 11000 meters, squawking 6527, contact Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 United 805，飞往广州，正在接近 Whiskey X-Ray India，保持 11000 米，应答机 6527，联系郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL805, approaching WXI, maintaining 11000 meters, squawking 6527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL805，接近 WXI，保持 11000 米，应答机 6527。

cards.audioText: C: United 805, radar contact, offset 3 miles right of track, reduce speed to Mach 0.75 due to Wuhan Control restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 805，雷达识别，向航迹右侧偏置 3 海里，因武汉管制限制，减速至马赫 0.75。
cards.referenceText: Offset 3 miles right of track, reduce speed to M.75, UAL805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 向航迹右侧偏置 3 海里，减速至 M.75，UAL805。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates there is a thunderstorm ahead, request Zhengzhou Control for 20 miles deviation right of track and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: B：气象雷达显示前方有雷暴，向郑州管制请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里，并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL805, our weather radar indicates there is a thunderstorm ahead, request 20 miles deviation right of track.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL805，我们气象雷达显示前方有雷暴，请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里。

cards.audioText: C: United 805, 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 805，同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告。
cards.referenceText: 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather, UAL805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告，UAL805。

cards.audioText:
C: United 805, reduce speed to Mach 0.72.
B: Advise Zhengzhou Control Mach 0.72 is not acceptable, it's too low for your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：United 805，减速至马赫 0.72。
B：告知郑州管制 M.72 不能接受，对你们飞机来说太低。
cards.referenceText: Negative, unable M.72, it's too low for our aircraft, UAL805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不能接受，无法保持 M.72，对我们飞机来说太低，UAL805。

cards.audioText: C: United 805, Zhengzhou Control, maintain Mach 0.75, we are limiting the number of aircraft flying through Wuhan Control area due to Wuhan radar failure.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 805，郑州管制，保持马赫 0.75，因武汉雷达故障，我们正在限制飞越武汉管制区的飞机数量。

cards.audioText:
C: United 805, what is your estimated time for OBLIK?
B: Inform Zhengzhou Control your estimated time for OBLIK is 0638 Zulu.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：United 805，你预计到达 OBLIK 的时间是多少？
B：告知郑州管制预计 0638Z 到达 OBLIK。

cards.audioText: C: United 805, make an orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 0646.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 805，右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 0646。
cards.referenceText: Orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 0646, UAL805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 0646，UAL805。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed the orbit, ask Zhengzhou Control to track direct to OBLIK.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已完成盘旋，请求郑州管制直飞 OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL805, request track direct to OBLIK.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL805，请求直飞 OBLIK。

cards.audioText: C: United 805, negative direct to OBLIK, turn left heading 130 to intercept Amber 461.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 805，不能直飞 OBLIK，左转航向 130，切入 Amber 461。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 130 to intercept A461, UAL805.

cards.audioText: C: United 805, 50 miles to OBLIK, contact Wuhan Control on 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 805，距 OBLIK 50 海里，联系武汉管制118.9。

cards.audioText: B: You are over OBLIK at time 0646, maintaining 11000 meters, you are estimating Zulu Foxtrot at time 0658, your next way point is Whiskey Uniform Hotel, make a standard position report to Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你 0646 飞越 OBLIK，保持 11000 米，预计 0658 到达 Zulu Foxtrot，下一航路点 Whiskey Uniform Hotel，向武汉管制作标准位置报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL805, over OBLIK 0646, maintaining 11000 meters, estimating ZF 0658, next WUH.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL805，0646 飞越 OBLIK，保持 11000 米，预计 ZF 0658，下一点 WUH。

cards.audioText: C: United 805, roger, maintain 11000 meters, report Zulu Foxtrot.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 805，收到，保持 11000 米，报告 Zulu Foxtrot。

cards.audioText: C: United 805, radar failure, for identification, reset squawk 3572.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 805，雷达故障，为识别，重设应答机 3572。

cards.audioText: C: United 805, radar identified, resume own navigation, track direct to DAPRO.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 805，雷达已识别，恢复自主导航，直飞 DAPRO。
cards.referenceText: Resume own navigation, track direct to DAPRO, UAL805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 恢复自主导航，直飞 DAPRO，UAL805。
